en.headline: Sandy Ridge data cluster set for phased opening in mid-2027
en.dek: CLP Power and Range Intelligent Computing said the Northern Metropolis project would start earlier than the original 2029 target, with investment above HK$23.8 billion.
body: The Sandy Ridge data park in the Northern Metropolis is expected to begin phased operations in mid-2027, earlier than the original 2029 target, CLP Power Hong Kong and Range Intelligent Computing said at a ceremony on Wednesday.

Acting Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Lillian Cheong Man-lei said a cross-bureaux task force had shortened approvals so the first phase could be completed about a year after the tender and land grant. She said the park is expected to provide 180,000 peta-floating point operations per second of computing power by around 2030, about 36 times Hong Kong's current level.

The government put cumulative investment at more than HK$23.8 billion. Range will handle investment, construction and operations, while CLP will supply electricity. CLP Holdings chief executive Chiang Tung-keung said the utility would have enough capacity over the next decade to support demand equivalent to three or four parks of similar scale.
CLP said it planned to buy more traceable zero-carbon energy from the mainland. Cheong said the first three years of operation were projected to generate about HK$4.6 billion in economic output.

zh.headline: 沙嶺數據設施群料2027年中分期啟用
zh.dek: 中電與潤澤科技舉行啟航典禮，項目較原定2029年提前，累計投入逾238億元，首期爭取明年中啟用。
body: 北都沙嶺數據園區預計2027年中開始分階段投入服務，較原定2029年目標提前。中電香港與潤澤科技周三舉行項目合作啟航典禮。
署理創新科技及工業局局長張曼莉表示，由創科局牽頭的跨部門專班壓縮審批流程，項目可在開標及批地約一年後首階段落成。她指園區預計2030年前後提供18萬PFLOPS算力，相當於香港現時水平約36倍。
政府指累計投入超過238億元，由潤澤科技負責投資、建設及營運，中電提供電力。中電控股行政總裁蔣東強表示，未來十年供電能力足以應付相等於三至四個同規模園區的需求。
中電表示計劃向內地採購可追溯的零碳能源。張曼莉指園區投入營運首三年預計可創造約46億元經濟產出。
